'''Collector Murmrgh''' is a [[mole miner]] [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] who was intended to be recruited at the [[Milepost Zero (location)|Milepost Zero]] branch of the [[Blue Ridge Caravan Company]] in [[Appalachia]] {{in|FO76}}. Recruiting Murmrgh was meant to cost 200 [[Supplies]], but the character remained [[Fallout 76 cut content|cut content]].

Previously known in the files as '''Grrmrrgh''', Murmrgh was never able to be recruited in the live game, but had been in the game's files since the ''Milepost Zero'' update's release. Like [[Windy Park]], Murmrgh appeared in the [[Public Test Server]] and the patch notes indicated that Murmrgh was intended to appear in a future release. Murmrgh and Windy were both referenced on the [[Milepost Zero terminal entries]] in-game. However, the ''[[Burning Springs (update)|Burning Springs]]'' update officially discontinued the Milepost Zero gameplay, making Collector Murmrgh cut content. Although Windy was retooled for ''Burning Springs'', Collector Murmrgh was not.

===Other interactions===
Although not a normal vendor with a trading menu, Murmrgh would offer eight "mystery crates" to purchase with [[Supplies]] through the dialogue tree.
* 10 {{icon|supplies}} - Basic Mystery Crate
* 25 {{icon|supplies}} - [[The Forest|Forest]] Mystery Crate
* 25 {{icon|supplies}} - [[Toxic Valley]] Mystery Crate
* 25 {{icon|supplies}} - [[Savage Divide]] Mystery Crate
* 50 {{icon|supplies}} - [[Skyline Valley (region)|Skyline Valley]] Mystery Crate
* 50 {{icon|supplies}} - [[Ash Heap]] Mystery Crate
* 100 {{icon|supplies}} - [[The Mire|Mire]] Mystery Crate
* 100 {{icon|supplies}} - [[Cranberry Bog]] Mystery Crate
Each mystery crate would award random loot tied to the region it was named after (except for the basic crate, which had more general loot). This would include modified weapons and plans the player did not yet know.
